reason: Provides persistent AI memory through five tools for reading, listing, searching, writing, and appending local Markdown or text files in a configured vault, with a sidebar reference panel.

summaries.zh: 通过本地配置的 Obsidian 或 Markdown vault 为 AI 提供读取、列出、搜索、写入和追加记忆文件的工具，并显示侧边栏面板。
summaries.en: Provides AI with persistent memory tools for reading, listing, searching, writing, and appending files in a configured local Obsidian or Markdown vault, plus a sidebar panel.

capabilities: Reads Markdown and text files within a configured local vault path
Lists files and directories within the configured vault path
Searches Markdown and text files within the vault
Writes or overwrites files within the vault
Appends content to files within the vault
Provides a sidebar panel with vault status and tool references
